meta.description: Hirose LION FX USD/TRY swap plus same-timestamp fixed-hour FX cost aligned to the same holding interval
meta.market_rate_source: Yahoo Finance chart API: USDTRY=X and USDJPY=X
meta.market_rate_method: same-timestamp Yahoo 1h close anchored at 23:00 JST; fallback to nearest earlier common hour within 3h; 05:00-08:59 JST excluded
meta.fx_cost_method: DAILY = current Hirose-row fixed-time USDTRY to next Hirose-row fixed-time USDTRY, assigned to the starting row and converted at the next row same-timestamp TRYJPY; divide by elapsed calendar days. 7AVG = backward-looking 7-calendar-day USDTRY deterioration / 7
meta.normalization: swap=sell_yen/Hirose accrual days; DAILY FX cost=interval FX loss/elapsed calendar days, never divided by Hirose swap accrual days
meta.fx_cost_sign: positive=FX loss/cost for USDTRY short, negative=FX gain
meta.market_day_boundary: JST calendar day; same-timestamp anchor preferred at 23:00 JST
